name: Implementation Stage Analysis Rubric
description: Evaluation criteria for a Threat Model Spec Analysis Report produced at the Implementation PDLC stage.

categories.name: Evidence Support
categories.description: Whether every finding cites specific, verifiable evidence rather than an unsupported assertion.

options.label: Pass
criteria: Every Finding cites at least one Evidence with a file+line locator or equivalent

options.label: Partial
criteria: Most findings cite evidence but at least one is unsupported

options.label: Fail
criteria: Findings present with no cited evidence at all

categories.evaluationPrompt: Does every Finding's evidenceIds resolve to a real Evidence object with a specific locator (not just a vague description)?

categories.name: Reachability
categories.description: Whether findings establish that attacker-controlled input can actually reach the vulnerable operation, not just that a risky pattern exists in isolation.

options.label: Pass
criteria: Findings trace a path from an untrusted input source to the vulnerable sink

options.label: Partial
criteria: Vulnerable pattern identified but reachability from untrusted input not established

options.label: Fail
criteria: Findings describe theoretical patterns with no reachability analysis

categories.evaluationPrompt: For each vulnerability Finding, does the description or evidence establish that attacker-controlled input can reach the flagged code, not just that the pattern exists somewhere?

categories.name: ASPM Domain Coverage
categories.description: Whether the report addresses all five implementation-stage ASPM domains, or explicitly states which were out of scope.

options.label: Pass
criteria: All 5 domains (git-posture, code-security, secret-pii-scan, open-source-security, sbom) analyzed or explicitly marked not-applicable

options.label: Partial
criteria: Most domains covered but at least one silently omitted

options.label: Fail
criteria: Only one domain covered with no statement about the rest

categories.evaluationPrompt: Does the report address every implementation-stage ASPM domain, or explicitly state which were skipped and why?

categories.name: Drift Detection
categories.description: Whether implementation is checked against the Builder Definition design, not evaluated in isolation.

options.label: Pass
criteria: At least one ArchitectureAssertion compares implementation reality to the Builder Definition design

options.label: Partial
criteria: Some awareness of the design intent but no formal ArchitectureAssertion recorded

options.label: Fail
criteria: No comparison to design intent at all

categories.evaluationPrompt: Is there at least one ArchitectureAssertion comparing what was implemented to what the Builder Definition stage required?
